messages:
Ravi (AE): KestralBank wants a 4-day POC next week. Requirements: Private/VPC connectivity, perimeter TLS inspection that may rewrite SNI, and a single allowlist egress IP for their firewall. Need: 1) can PrivateLink work with their DPI? 2) short pasteable fw snippet, 3) rough POC pricing for packet. @Nora @Theo @Mina

Nora (Solutions): Yes, with tradeoffs. PrivateLink (interface EPs) keeps ingress inside their VPC, but our backend still egresses from Redwood-managed IPs. If their DPI terminates or rewrites TLS/SNI, mTLS or cert checks can fail. Two recommended patterns: (A) PrivateLink only and customer preserves TLS passthrough; (B) deploy a lightweight connector in their VPC so DPI runs upstream of Redwood egress (preserves client IPs and logs).

Theo (NetOps): Pasteable firewall snippet (minimal):
```
# KestralBank POC allowlist (example)
# replace <REDFW_EGRESS_IP> and <PRIVLINK_ENI_CIDR> with values we provide
ALLOW tcp from <app_subnets> to <PRIVLINK_ENI_CIDR> port 443
ALLOW tcp from <connector_subnets> to <REDFW_EGRESS_IP> ports 443
ALLOW udp from <connector_subnets> to 8.8.8.8 port 53
```

Theo (NetOps): Egress IPs: we can provide a single /32 for the POC; prod uses HA pair. Connector option preserves client-srcip; PrivateLink-only does not.

Mina (Security): Two-line blurb for packet: "Redwood will deploy an interface endpoint (PrivateLink) into KestralBank-managed subnets for the POC. Outbound requests will egress from Redwood-managed static IP(s) provided for allowlisting; if KestralBanks DPI terminates or rewrites TLS/SNI, Redwood recommends a connector deployment in-customer-VPC or a documented cert re-issue flow to preserve mutual authentication and auditability."

Nora (Solutions): Rough POC pricing (estimates): static egress IP (pro-rated) = $1,500/month per IP; connector VM = $500/month + $1,000 one-time setup; Dedicated reserved capacity available for high throughput (quote on request). Numbers are illustrative until formal quote.

Ravi (AE): Action items: Nora to confirm IP(s) + formal quote by EOD Tue, Theo to upload 1-page topology sketch and minimal subnet sizing by Mon, Mina to add blurb to security packet. deploy-bot: New ticket POC-9053 created.

Nora (Solutions): Acknowledged, will follow up.

Theo (NetOps): Acknowledged, sketch Monday.

Mina (Security): Acknowledged, will add to packet.
